fields.name: tax_certificate_info
fields.fieldText:
Please complete this Section in full as your Certificate of Tax Residence, to ensure that your Application can be processed quickly.

Irrespective as to whether you pay Tax, this must be completed in all cases, detailing all countries of Tax Residence and your Tax Identification number(s). In line with Common Reporting Standards (CRS) and the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) it is a requirement to provide this information*. If you are unsure of your Tax Residence, we recommend you seek independent Tax Advice.
